notes.title: Base Game of Otherworld Legends Goes Free on Steam
notes.content:
Dear Warriors,

Thank you for your continued support of Otherworld Legends! We're thrilled to share that starting October 31st, the base game will be free-to-play on Steam, and everyone can join the adventure.

We plan to roll out an update at 10:00 AM (UTC+8) on October 31st, when the free-to-play model will officially go live. Please check the Steam store for the exact time the base game becomes free in your region.

After the game goes free, Akaisha, Gérard Quentin, and Oli, originally part of the base game, will be available as paid DLC. However, you can still unlock them using Hero Fragments (can be obtained by doing daily activities).
- Players who already own these heroes won't be affected and don't need to unlock them again.
- The DLC prices for Akaisha, Gérard Quentin, and Oli will be $1.99, $1.99, and $2.99 respectively (pricing may vary depending on your region). Alternatively, they can be unlocked with 12, 12, and 18 Hero Fragments.
- After the transition, Specific Hero Fragments for these heroes will be added to the Daily Activities' fragment rotation system. Exact details will be available in-game.

Thanks again for all your support! We're committed to bringing you more exciting content, and we hope both new and returning players have a blast!

About Removing Fabled Article System
notes.content:
We are sorry to inform you that we will remove the Fabled Article system in the October update. Meanwhile, a new system will enter the game, to some extent, replacing the Fabled Article and reserving some best parts of it.
It has come to our attention that the Fabled Article system has a rather mediocre performance with little popularity among warriors. Also, it will conflict with the system we are crafting right now and restrains the game design in some cases. Therefore, after careful consideration, we've decided to remove the Fabled Article system in the October update. Once removed, the resources spent will be returned. We will take time to rethink about it and hopefully we could bring back a more refined system to you in the future.
For more information about the new system, we will keep you posted in future announcements.

notes.content:
[b]We can assure you that the online co-op mode is still available on our Steam version. And you can for sure invite your Steam friends to join your adventure in the mirage. [/b]

For example, the room could not be joined or the player could not see their teammates in a multiplayer session. Therefore, we temporarily removed the “online co-op” tag and started burning the midnight oil to fix those issues in order to get the game pass the review and have it launched as planned. 

And sorry that it might have caused some confusion among players. Please be assured that we understand the online co-op mode is a very important feature for our players, and we promise that we will spare no efforts in maintaining and improving it in order to bring you a satisfying gaming experience with your friends.
